title: Congressional source puts crash-retrieval programs near 100% likely

tellings.quote: this. I talked to a a congressional source told me um I asked point blank, what's your confidence level in in the existence of such programs? The answer was hovering around 100%.

plain: Merrick von Renenamp, a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says he asked someone who works in the US Congress a direct question sometime in the 2020s: how sure are you that secret programs exist to recover crashed craft not made by humans? According to von Renenamp, the source answered that their confidence was close to 100 percent. If that were true, it would mean people inside government believe such recovered craft are real.
